title: Performance tests: a tolerant mode for older Exudyn versions down to 1.11
author: Claude-JG
description: The performance suite of today run with an installed older Exudyn (not older than 1.11), recording the models that are compatible with it and skipping the others, so that the history gets the same models for older versions.
releaseNotes: runPerformanceTests.py --tolerant measures an older installed Exudyn, down to 1.11, with the performance models of today: models that raise are skipped, differing results recorded, and for versions before the renames of 1.12.256 the new item, Create and settings names are translated (performanceCompatibility.py); the performance history holds the tolerant runs of 1.11.0 and 1.12.0.dev1 and the text logs of 1.9.0 to 1.13.174.
